items.desc: Greatly I toured Greatly I tried Greatly I probed the powers What mumbled Odin, approaching the pyre by itself In Baldur's ear? Sorcery she played Her visions become true. Seidh is part 3 of a music video triology together with Læknisgaldr and Slagt, all from our upcoming album release Sagas. The music video trilogy deals with the trauma induced by warfare and most importantly, how to heal. Seidh draws its breath from the oldest layers of the North, where ritual, poetry, and prophecy were not yet separated. Credits: DIRECTED BY Gornoss CAMERA, LIGHTING and EDIT Gornoss Additional Camera Operat

cm.t: Norway here. For those who dont know- 'Seid' or 'Seidh' as Heilung write- is essentially 'magic'. So what they do is 'generating seid', freely translated. In old Norse we also used the expression 'Seidmann', cant be directly translated, it can be seen as a mixture of Medicine Man, Druid etc. Women could also have Seid incorporated in themselves, and be able to generate Seid
cm.ko: 노르웨이에서. '세이드' 또는 '세이데'라는 용어는 헤일룽이 사용하는 용어로, 기본적으로 '마법'을 의미합니다. 따라서 그들은 '세이드를 생성'하는 것을 의미합니다. 고대 노르드에서는 '세이드만'이라는 표현도 사용했는데, 이는 직접 번역하기는 어렵지만, 의사나 드루이드와 유사한 역할을 수행했을 것으로 보입니다.
